definition: The settings that control how a device or program works.
example: Check the gateway configuration before restarting it.
exampleZh: 重启网关前先检查配置。

definition: A device that connects one network or system to another.
example: The gateway sends pressure readings to the platform.
exampleZh: 网关将压力读数发送到平台。

definition: A difference between two things that should agree.
example: A configuration mismatch caused the missing data.
exampleZh: 配置不匹配导致数据缺失。
collocation: a mismatch between A and B

definition: A level at which a rule or action starts to apply.
example: The alarm triggers when pressure exceeds the threshold.
exampleZh: 压力超过阈值时会触发报警。

definition: A small storage location in a device that holds a value.
example: This register stores the compressor temperature.
meaningZh: 寄存器（设备数据存储位置）
exampleZh: 这个寄存器存储空压机温度。

definition: The time between repeated requests for new data.
example: A shorter polling interval increases network traffic.
exampleZh: 更短的轮询间隔会增加网络流量。

definition: The order in which the bytes of a number are stored or sent.
example: The wrong byte order can turn a valid reading into nonsense.
exampleZh: 错误的字节序可能让有效读数变得毫无意义。

definition: The useful data carried inside a message.
example: The MQTT payload contains readings from three meters.
meaningZh: 消息载荷；有效数据部分
exampleZh: 这条 MQTT 消息的载荷包含三块电表的读数。

definition: A value used to check whether data was damaged or changed.
example: The checksum does not match the received frame.
exampleZh: 校验和与收到的数据帧不匹配。

definition: The end of the allowed waiting time for a response.
example: A timeout occurs if the meter does not respond.
exampleZh: 如果电表没有响应，就会发生超时。

definition: The delay between a request and its response.
example: High latency makes live readings feel out of date.
exampleZh: 高延迟会让实时读数显得滞后。

definition: The amount of data or work handled in a period of time.
example: The new service handles more messages without losing throughput.
meaningZh: 吞吐量；单位时间处理量
exampleZh: 新服务处理更多消息，同时保持吞吐量。

definition: A request to get particular information from a database.
example: Limit the query to one station and a short time range.
exampleZh: 将查询限定在一个站点和较短的时间范围内。

definition: Information used to prove who you are when you sign in.
example: The user cannot sign in with the saved credentials.
exampleZh: 用户无法使用已保存的登录凭据登录。

definition: The right to access something or perform an action.
example: This account has permission to view only one station.
exampleZh: 这个账号仅有查看一个站点的权限。

definition: The structure that defines tables and fields in a database.
example: The local schema differs from the production schema.
exampleZh: 本地数据库结构与生产环境不同。

definition: A database structure that helps find rows more quickly.
example: An index on device ID can make the query faster.
exampleZh: 设备 ID 上的索引可以加快查询。

definition: A stored value showing when something happened.
example: Compare the device timestamp with the server time.
exampleZh: 将设备时间戳与服务器时间进行比较。

definition: A marker showing that a database value is missing or unknown.
example: A null reading is different from a reading of zero.
exampleZh: 空值读数与数值为零的读数不同。

definition: An extra copy of something that already exists.
example: Duplicate records made the daily total look too high.
meaningZh: 重复项；重复的（名词或形容词读音）
exampleZh: 重复记录使每日总量显得过高。

definition: No longer fresh or current.
example: The dashboard is showing stale data from yesterday.
exampleZh: 仪表盘显示的是昨天尚未更新的数据。

definition: A link showing how one value or item relates to another.
example: Check the mapping between meter addresses and device IDs.
exampleZh: 检查电表地址与设备 ID 之间的映射。

definition: To compare different records and make them agree.
example: Reconcile the platform totals with the meter readings.
exampleZh: 将平台汇总值与电表读数核对。

definition: To make the same result or problem happen again.
example: I could reproduce the bug with an empty payload.
exampleZh: 我能用空载荷复现这个问题。

definition: To check that something is correct or true.
example: Verify the register address against the device manual.
exampleZh: 对照设备手册核实寄存器地址。

definition: A limit that affects what you can do.
example: We need to work within the gateway memory constraints.
exampleZh: 我们需要在网关内存限制内开展工作。

definition: Something you accept as true before checking it.
example: Do not base the fix on an untested assumption.
exampleZh: 不要基于未经检验的假设修复问题。

definition: An alternative used when the preferred option fails.
example: Use the cached value as a fallback if the request fails.
exampleZh: 如果请求失败，使用缓存值作为备用方案。

definition: A problem that returns or appears after a software change.
example: The update caused a regression in the login flow.
meaningZh: 回归问题（软件修改引入的故障）
exampleZh: 更新导致登录流程出现回归问题。

definition: A return to an earlier version or state.
example: Prepare a rollback before changing the production service.
meaningZh: 回滚（名词；动词写作 roll back）
exampleZh: 更改生产服务前先准备回滚方案。

definition: To put software into the environment where it will run.
example: Deploy the fix after checking it on a test server.
exampleZh: 在测试服务器上检查修复后再部署。

definition: A separate line of development in a code repository.
example: Create a branch for the gateway parser changes.
exampleZh: 为空网关解析器的修改创建一个分支。

definition: A clash between code changes that cannot be combined automatically.
example: Resolve the merge conflict before updating the shared branch.
exampleZh: 更新共享分支前先解决合并冲突。

definition: To improve code structure without changing its intended behavior.
example: Refactor the parser so each protocol has a clear handler.
exampleZh: 重构解析器，使每种协议都有清晰的处理器。

definition: Still available, but no longer recommended for new use.
example: This deprecated field remains for older clients.
meaningZh: 已弃用的；不建议继续使用的
exampleZh: 这个已弃用的字段仍为旧客户端保留。

definition: A library or component that a program needs to work.
example: A missing dependency prevented the service from starting.
exampleZh: 缺失的依赖项导致服务无法启动。

definition: The part of a process that limits its overall speed.
example: The database query became the main bottleneck.
exampleZh: 数据库查询成为主要瓶颈。

definition: To find the cause of a problem and try to fix it.
example: Troubleshoot the data path one device at a time.
exampleZh: 沿着数据链路逐台设备排查故障。

definition: The underlying reason a problem happened.
example: A wrong meter address was the root cause of the missing readings.
exampleZh: 错误的电表地址是读数缺失的根本原因。

definition: Happening sometimes, with gaps in between.
example: The gateway has an intermittent connection problem.
exampleZh: 网关有间歇性连接故障。

definition: To run an engine while the vehicle is not moving.
example: The engine runs smoothly at idle but shakes under load.
exampleZh: 发动机怠速平稳，但带负荷时抖动。

definition: For an engine to stop running unexpectedly.
example: The engine may stall when the car comes to a stop.
exampleZh: 车辆停下时，发动机可能会熄火。

definition: For fuel in an engine cylinder to fail to burn correctly.
example: A worn spark plug can cause the engine to misfire.
meaningZh: 发动机失火；燃烧不正常
exampleZh: 磨损的火花塞可能导致发动机失火。

definition: A turning force, such as the force an engine applies to the wheels.
example: This motor delivers strong torque at low speeds.
exampleZh: 这台电机在低速时能输出强劲扭矩。

definition: The system that transfers engine power to the wheels through gears.
example: The transmission hesitates before shifting into second gear.
exampleZh: 变速器在换入二挡前有些迟疑。

definition: A device that connects or disconnects the engine from the transmission.
example: A slipping clutch can make the engine speed rise without much acceleration.
exampleZh: 离合器打滑可能导致发动机转速上升，但车辆加速不明显。

definition: A control that changes how much power an engine produces.
example: The car responds quickly to small throttle inputs.
exampleZh: 车辆对轻微的油门输入响应迅速。

definition: An increase in speed.
example: The reviewer praised the car for its smooth acceleration.
exampleZh: 评测者称赞这辆车加速平顺。

definition: The act of slowing or stopping a vehicle with its brakes.
example: Heavy braking made the steering wheel shake.
exampleZh: 大力制动时方向盘发生抖动。

definition: The grip between the tires and the road.
example: Wet roads reduce traction during acceleration.
exampleZh: 湿滑路面会降低加速时的抓地力。

definition: The parts that support a vehicle and absorb bumps from the road.
example: The soft suspension makes long trips more comfortable.
exampleZh: 柔软的悬架让长途出行更加舒适。

definition: The adjustment of wheel angles so the wheels point correctly.
example: Uneven tire wear may be a sign of poor alignment.
exampleZh: 轮胎磨损不均可能是车轮定位不良的表现。

definition: A repeated shaking movement.
example: The driver noticed a vibration at highway speeds.
exampleZh: 驾驶员在高速行驶时注意到了抖动。

definition: A liquid used to carry heat away from an engine or other parts.
example: A low coolant level can lead to overheating.
exampleZh: 冷却液液位过低可能导致过热。

definition: To become hotter than is safe or useful.
example: The engine began to overheat in slow traffic.
exampleZh: 发动机在缓慢车流中开始过热。

definition: An opening that lets liquid or gas escape by accident.
example: The mechanic found a small oil leak near the filter.
exampleZh: 技师在滤清器附近发现了一处小漏油点。

definition: A seal placed between parts to prevent gas or liquid from escaping.
example: A damaged gasket can allow coolant to escape.
exampleZh: 损坏的密封垫会让冷却液泄漏。

definition: A part that creates the spark that lights fuel in a gasoline engine.
example: The shop replaced the worn spark plugs.
exampleZh: 修理店更换了磨损的火花塞。

definition: The system or process that starts fuel burning in an engine.
example: The mechanic checked the ignition system first.
exampleZh: 技师首先检查了点火系统。

definition: A device that stores energy and supplies electrical power.
example: The battery may be weak if the starter turns slowly.
exampleZh: 如果起动机转动缓慢，可能是蓄电池电量不足。

definition: A device that generates electricity while an engine runs.
example: A faulty alternator may fail to keep the battery charged.
exampleZh: 故障的汽车发电机可能无法持续为蓄电池充电。

definition: How well a vehicle uses fuel to travel a given distance.
example: Steady driving can improve fuel efficiency.
meaningZh: 燃油经济性；燃油利用效率
exampleZh: 平稳驾驶可以改善燃油经济性。

definition: The total distance a vehicle has traveled; also distance per unit of fuel.
example: The car has high mileage but a complete service history.
meaningZh: 累计行驶里程；也可指每单位燃油的行驶里程
exampleZh: 这辆车里程较高，但保养记录完整。

definition: To become unusable or less effective through repeated use.
example: Brake pads wear out faster in stop-and-go traffic.
exampleZh: 刹车片在走走停停的路况下磨损更快。

definition: A request by a manufacturer to bring a product back for a safety fix.
example: The manufacturer issued a recall for a fuel-pump fault.
exampleZh: 制造商因燃油泵故障发布了召回通知。

definition: A promise to repair or replace a product under stated conditions.
example: The repair was covered by the vehicle warranty.
exampleZh: 这次维修属于车辆保修范围。

definition: Regular care that keeps equipment working well.
example: Routine maintenance helps prevent unexpected breakdowns.
exampleZh: 日常保养有助于防止意外故障。

definition: How a vehicle responds when it changes direction.
example: The new tires improved the car's handling in the rain.
exampleZh: 新轮胎改善了这辆车在雨中的操控表现。

definition: The system or action used to control a vehicle's direction.
example: The steering feels heavier at low speeds.
exampleZh: 低速时转向感觉更沉。

definition: One marked strip of a road for a line of vehicles.
example: The system warns the driver before the car leaves its lane.
exampleZh: 车辆驶离车道前，系统会提醒驾驶员。

definition: A unit used to describe how much power an engine or motor produces.
example: More horsepower does not always mean a better driving experience.
exampleZh: 更高的马力并不总意味着更好的驾驶体验。

definition: The distance a vehicle can travel before it needs fuel or charging.
example: Cold weather can reduce an electric car's range.
exampleZh: 寒冷天气可能缩短电动汽车的续航里程。

definition: Slowing a vehicle by turning some of its motion into stored electrical energy.
example: Regenerative braking sends some energy back to the battery.
meaningZh: 再生制动；制动能量回收
exampleZh: 再生制动将部分能量送回电池。

definition: An area around a vehicle that a driver cannot easily see.
example: Check the blind spot before changing lanes.
exampleZh: 变道前检查视野盲区。

definition: To decide that something is not a possible cause or explanation.
example: Test the battery first to rule out a charging problem.
exampleZh: 先测试电池，排除充电问题。

definition: In AI, using a trained model to produce an answer or prediction.
example: The company wants to lower the cost of running inference.
meaningZh: 推理（AI 模型生成结果的过程）
exampleZh: 该公司希望降低运行推理的成本。

definition: In AI, the process of adjusting a model by learning from data.
example: Training a larger model may require more computing power.
meaningZh: 训练（AI 模型学习数据的过程）
exampleZh: 训练更大的模型可能需要更多算力。

definition: A small piece of material containing electronic circuits.
example: Demand for AI chips remains a major topic in technology news.
exampleZh: 对 AI 芯片的需求仍是科技新闻的重要话题。

definition: A material whose electrical behavior makes it useful for chips.
example: The firm supplies equipment to semiconductor manufacturers.
exampleZh: 该公司向半导体制造商供应设备。

definition: The profit a company makes during a particular period.
example: Investors are waiting for the company's quarterly earnings.
exampleZh: 投资者正在等待该公司的季度盈利数据。

definition: The money a company receives from selling goods or services before costs.
example: Revenue rose, but higher costs put pressure on profit.
exampleZh: 营收上升，但成本增加给利润带来压力。

definition: The share of revenue left as profit after the relevant costs.
example: Lower production costs helped improve the profit margin.
exampleZh: 生产成本降低有助于提高利润率。

definition: A company's own estimate of its future business results.
example: The company raised its revenue guidance for next quarter.
meaningZh: 业绩指引；公司对未来业绩的预期
exampleZh: 公司上调了下一季度的营收指引。

definition: An estimate of what is likely to happen in the future.
example: The forecast assumes demand will remain strong.
exampleZh: 这一预测假定需求将保持强劲。

definition: A period when market prices rise, often after a fall.
example: Technology shares led a broad market rally.
exampleZh: 科技股引领市场普涨。

definition: A sharp fall in prices, sales, or activity.
example: Weak demand led to a slump in chip sales.
exampleZh: 需求疲软导致芯片销售大幅下滑。

definition: The degree to which prices change quickly and sharply.
example: Unexpected policy news increased market volatility.
exampleZh: 意外的政策消息加剧了市场波动。

definition: An estimate of what a company or asset is worth.
example: Strong growth expectations pushed the company's valuation higher.
exampleZh: 强劲的增长预期推高了该公司的估值。

definition: A standard used to compare performance or results.
example: The model performed well on the benchmark but struggled with real tasks.
exampleZh: 该模型在基准测试中表现良好，但处理实际任务时存在困难。

definition: The percentage charged for borrowing money or paid on savings.
example: A change in the interest rate can affect borrowing costs.
exampleZh: 利率变化会影响借贷成本。

definition: A general rise in prices over time.
example: Slower inflation does not mean prices are falling.
exampleZh: 通胀放缓并不意味着价格正在下降。

definition: A tax on goods brought into a country.
example: The proposed tariff could increase the cost of imported parts.
exampleZh: 拟议的关税可能提高进口零部件的成本。

definition: A rule that limits selling or sending goods to another country.
example: An export restriction can limit access to advanced chips.
exampleZh: 出口限制可能限制先进芯片的获取。

definition: An official rule controlling how an activity is carried out.
example: The debate focused on regulation of powerful AI systems.
exampleZh: 辩论聚焦于对强大 AI 系统的监管。

definition: A person with senior responsibility for running an organization.
example: The executive said the company would increase investment.
exampleZh: 这位高管表示公司将增加投资。

definition: Money or effort put into something with an expected future benefit.
example: The project requires a large investment in data centers.
exampleZh: 该项目需要向数据中心投入大量资金。

definition: The amount of a product or service that buyers want.
example: Demand for computing power is driving new construction.
exampleZh: 对算力的需求正在推动新设施建设。

definition: The planned introduction of a new product or service.
example: The rollout will begin with a small group of users.
exampleZh: 此次推出将从一小部分用户开始。

definition: A choice where gaining one benefit means giving up another.
example: There is a trade-off between model speed and accuracy.
exampleZh: 模型速度与准确性之间存在取舍。
collocation: a trade-off between A and B

definition: A sudden, large increase.
example: A surge in demand put pressure on chip suppliers.
exampleZh: 需求激增给芯片供应商带来了压力。
